motifs.name: upper_left_cliff_saplings
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-left rocky cliff face with thin vertical rock contour lines and sparse leaning saplings emerging from the edge. Include the small dark leaf clusters and dry-brush cliff striations only, without the blank sky/mist beyond what is needed around the strokes.
must_preserve: fine ink outline of cliff edge
thin sapling trunks and forked twigs
soft pale wash defining the cliff mass

motifs.name: left_massive_pine_trunks
motifs.description: Isolate the large old pine trunks rising along the left side, including exposed roots, twisting bark, lower knots, and the dark pine-needle masses attached to the trunks. Avoid including the central horizontal branch canopy except where it joins the trunk.
must_preserve: gnarled root shapes at the cliff base
dark ink bark ridges and longitudinal striations
strong dark contour lines against pale rock wash

motifs.name: central_windblown_pine_branch
motifs.description: Isolate the broad windblown pine limb extending from the left trunk across the center, with twisting branch structure and scattered pine-needle tufts. Include the curved main branch, smaller offshoots, and hanging needle clusters, but not the distant mountains behind it.
must_preserve: clustered pine needles rendered as fine dark strokes
irregular ink-wash shadow under the branch

motifs.name: hanging_bamboo_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the drooping bamboo-like foliage descending from the central slope toward the middle, with slender stems and many narrow leaves. Include the fine leaf clusters and lightly washed supporting bank only where attached.
must_preserve: subtle pale hillside wash behind the foliage
small branching joints along the stems

motifs.name: distant_layered_mountains_mist
motifs.description: Isolate the pale middle-distance mountain range and misty water/valley band across the right half, including the soft triangular peaks and layered silhouettes. Exclude foreground trees and any seals at the lower right edge.
must_preserve: misty horizontal transition into open water/sky
minimal ink linework and subdued tonal gradation

motifs.description: Isolate the cluster of small leafless trees on the rocky promontory in the lower middle-right, including branching twig networks, dark knotted trunks, and the uneven rock base. Avoid the red seal and unrelated far-right lower edge.
must_preserve: short grass strokes at the base
light wash separating rock from misty water

motifs.name: foreground_rolling_bank_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground rolling bank with grasses, small shrubs, and low rounded rocks. Include the sloping earth forms, clumps of grass, and small leafy bushes, while excluding the bottom-left seal and outer border area.
must_preserve: rounded contour of the earthen bank
low rock outlines and shaded hollows
soft ochre wash with darker ink accents
